items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, my wife. >> [INTERVIEWEE] My second wife.

ctx.x: You know, I find this with, with a number of musicians, is that there's a certain, there was in the, it seems like in the black community there's a certain amount of formality. In other words, you say, people call you Alvin. Did anybody call you Al? No, my wife.
My second wife. Oh. My second wife.
You said I'm going to call you Al. Okay. Yeah, tell me, cause, Tommy.
